summarize_aria_constants: summarize the aria_constants module which defines key strings for Meta Aria glasses EFM3D data fields
lookup_aria_cam_info: look up the ARIA_CAM_INFO dictionary to find camera names, stream IDs, and resolution for RGB and SLAM cameras
lookup_resolution_map: look up the RESOLUTION_MAP dictionary to find supported image resolutions for RGB and SLAM streams by index
lookup_aria_img_keys: look up the ARIA_IMG list to find the key strings for accessing RGB, SLAM left, and SLAM right image tensors
lookup_aria_obbs_keys: look up the ARIA_OBB_* constants to find key strings for oriented bounding box data including padded, predicted, and tracked boxes
